theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_weyl_mollify_harmonic
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R ε : ℝ) (W φ : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < ε → IntegrableOn W (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ ζ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R → ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, W y * ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ζ y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m φ) → (∀ y : Euclid n, ε ≤ ‖y‖ → φ y = 0) → (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y, (ball (0 : Euclid n) R).indicator W y * φ (x - y))) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) (R - ε), ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun x => ∫ y, (ball (0 : Euclid n) R).indicator W y * φ (x - y)) x ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0
